title: Taiwanese American Association of Arizona 亞歷桑那州 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association of Arizona (TAAA) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (全美台灣同鄉會), serving the Taiwanese American community across the state of Arizona. As a TAA chapter, it operates within the national umbrella organization’s network of hometown associations dedicated to community connection, cultural preservation, and civic engagement among Taiwanese Americans in the United States.
